subject: Urgent: Mid-cycle seat migration & VAT reverse-charge — credit note needed
messages:
From: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@novalabs.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Pieter van Dijk <pieter.vd@novalabs.eu>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Mid-cycle seat migration + VAT reverse charge request

Hi Karthik,

We moved a block of seats between internal teams mid-cycle and are seeing a full-month charge on the 1 June invoice. Quick summary:
- Account: Novalabs (Acct #NL-7782)
- Billing plan: Dedicated - 120 seats (monthly)
- Change: 35 seats were migrated from Team Alpha to Team Beta effective 2027-06-10; Team Beta will be billed under a different PO/department going forward.
- What we need: a proration credit for the 35 seats for the period they were not on the origin PO (i.e., 10–30 June should be split appropriately), and the supplier invoice must support EU reverse-charge (we provided our VAT ID/EORI below).

VAT/EORI: NL123456789B01
PO (Team Beta): PO-98765

Can you confirm how Redwood will calculate the mid-cycle adjustment, whether you’ll issue a credit note or refund, and how the reverse-charge will be reflected on the corrected invoice? We need this for our AP team to post the adjustment before month-end.

Thanks,
Olivia Hart
Head of Ops — Novalabs
Olivia.hart@novalabs.co
+31 20 555 0199

Attachment: invoice_20270601.pdf (we included the June invoice in the first email to us)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@novalabs.co>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle seat migration + VAT reverse charge request

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear summary. We can handle this, and I’ll outline the proposed approach so we’re aligned: 

1) Proration calculation: we prorate seats by calendar-day basis. For the 35-seat migration effective 2027-06-10, we will compute pro rata credit for the period 2027-06-10 through 2027-06-30 for the origin PO, and a corresponding charge (or invoice reallocation) to the destination PO if requested.

2) Credit vs refund: by default we issue a credit note that is applied to the next invoice (or can be posted as a one-time refund on request). Please confirm preference — credit is faster for bookkeeping and will show as a credit_note applied to next cycle.

3) VAT / reverse-charge: to support reverse-charge under EU rules we need the customer VAT/EORI on the invoice and a standard reverse-charge notation on the supplier invoice. You provided NL123456789B01 which is good; confirm the exact legal entity name to print on the credit note/invoice.

Actions I’ll take: loop in Finance (Lauren) to produce a draft credit note and updated invoice; Marcus will schedule the webhook/invoice-update to your billing endpoint.

Could you confirm: (a) preference for credit vs refund; (b) legal entity name for the VAT invoice; and (c) whether you want the migrated seats billed to PO-98765 immediately or on the next cycle?

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle seat migration + VAT reverse charge request

Adding Finance details — I ran the proration and attached a calc sheet. Summary of our draft: 

- Period for proration: 2027-06-01 to 2027-06-30 (30 days). Migration effective 2027-06-10 => 9 days on origin PO (1–9 Jun) and 22 days on destination PO (10–30 Jun).
- Daily seat rate (per seat): EUR 15.00 (from invoice_20270601).
- Credit for origin PO (35 seats): 35 * 22 days * EUR15 / 30 = EUR 385.00 (rounded).
- We will issue a credit_note_draft.pdf referencing INV-20270601 and apply to next billing cycle by default.

Attachments: proration_calc_sheet.xlsx, credit_note_draft.pdf (draft)

Note: to apply reverse-charge we will print the customer VAT/EORI on the credit note and add the reverse-charge text: "VAT reversed under Article 194 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC — reverse charge applies." Please confirm legal entity name exactly as Novalabs wants it printed.

Marcus: once Olivia confirms, I’ll finalize the credit note and flag the invoice for reissue. We will also set the credit to show as a negative line on the next invoice if they prefer not to receive a refund.

— Lauren Bishop
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: Pieter van Dijk <pieter.vd@novalabs.eu>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@novalabs.co>, billing@novalabs.co
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 07:22:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle seat migration + VAT reverse charge request

Thanks Karthik / Lauren — confirmed: Novalabs legal name for invoicing is Novalabs B.V.; VAT/EORI NL123456789B01. We prefer a credit note applied to the next invoice rather than a refund.

A couple of asks from AP: 
- Please include the PO (PO-98765) on the updated invoice lines for the migrated seats.
- Can you attach the credit note as a PDF to the invoice email and send the invoice_receipt webhook to billing@novalabs.co (endpoint: https://billing.novalabs.co/webhooks/invoice-receipt)?
- We will sign a short amendment to record the seat move; please send a DocuSign envelope for the amendment (we do not need a price change section — just to record the department/PO association).

Regards,
Pieter
Novalabs — Finance Operations

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Pieter van Dijk <pieter.vd@novalabs.eu>, Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@novalabs.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle seat migration + VAT reverse charge request

Hi Pieter / Olivia — quick confirmation from ops: 

- We will issue credit_note CN-20270615-NL (attached draft) for EUR 385.00 and apply it to your next invoice.
- Updated invoice will include PO-98765 on the migrated-seat line and print "Novalabs B.V. — NL123456789B01" along with the reverse-charge note.
- Invoice email will include the credit note PDF attachment and we will POST an invoice_receipt webhook to https://billing.novalabs.co/webhooks/invoice-receipt once the updated invoice is generated (ETA 24 hours).
- DocuSign envelope for the seat amendment (ENVELOPE-ABC-123) is being sent to Pieter for signature.

If anything changes (refund instead of credit, immediate re-billing to destination PO, different effective date), please reply with details and we’ll re-run the calc.

Thanks — Marcus
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
Attachment: credit_note_draft.pdf
